meta_description:
4,695 likes, 54 comments - samsung on October 29, 2026: "For Jean-Pierre Bourhis, every stroke carries a dream forward.

A Senegalese Olympian, engineer in Paris, and selected Role Model for the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games @jojdakar2026, Jean-Pierre @jpbourhis wants young canoeists in Senegal to have the tools and support they need to grow.

With Galaxy technology in his hands, he helps athletes understand the water, build confidence, and move closer to their goals. #VoicesofGalaxy #OpenAlwaysWins #Samsung 

Watch the full film on YouTube.".
